name: sdd-loop
description: Agentic Spec-Driven Development loop: an SDD-outer / TDD-inner build loop driven from a stakeholder-validated PRD.md and an engineer-validated ARCHITECTURE.md. Main-session orchestrator + bounded subagents (sdd-phase-opener, sdd-issue-worker, sdd-merge-resolver) + deterministic hooks (SessionStart re-prime, PreToolUse test-first, PreToolUse landed-test warning, SubagentStop verify). Project-agnostic; parametrized per repo by .sdd/profile.md.
